targets.name: Kodiak Butte Delta Remnant
targets.description: Isolated erosional remnant exhibiting textbook Gilbert-type delta bottomsets and foresets. Highest priority evidence of ancient high-energy lake stage.
targets.dataSource: NASA Perseverance Rover Mastcam-Z Long Distance Imaging & CRISM
missingEvidence: Direct core drilling at steep scarp face not performed due to rover slope safety limit
references: Mangold et al., Science 2021 — Perseverance rover reveals an ancient delta-lake system at Jezero crater
PDS Geosciences Node: M2020 Mastcam-Z Sol 50–120 Mosaic

targets.name: South Séítah Cumulate Outcrop
targets.description: Coarse-grained olivine cumulate rock representing planetary magma ocean or thick layered intrusion. Key for radiometric dating of Jezero basin floor.
targets.dataSource: NASA Mars 2020 PIXL / SHERLOC Elemental Core Sample 'Dourbes'
missingEvidence: Radiometric age requires Mars Sample Return laboratory analysis on Earth
references: Liu et al., Science 2022 — An olivine cumulate outcrop on the floor of Jezero crater
NASA Mars 2020 Analyst's Notebook: Core Sample 'Dourbes' (Sol 257)

targets.name: Belva Crater Impact Rim & Ejecta
targets.description: Younger impact into delta deposit exposing 3D cross-sections of sedimentary beds and deep megabreccia blocks.
missingEvidence: Contact XRD mineralogy not collected inside crater floor

targets.name: Neretva Vallis Inflow Channel Breach
targets.description: Channel canyon through which violent catastrophic floods carved the Jezero crater rim and deposited boulder conglomerates.
targets.dataSource: NASA MGS MOLA & Mars Express HRSC Elevation Surveys
missingEvidence: Sub-meter boulder grain-size distribution limited to orbital HiRISE + long-range Mastcam-Z

targets.name: Vera Rubin Ridge (Hematite Crest)
targets.description: Narrow topographic ridge rich in crystalline hematite, indicating an ancient redox interface where groundwater met lake water.
targets.dataSource: NASA MSL Curiosity CheMin XRD & APXS Analysis
missingEvidence: No sample return cache capability on MSL Curiosity
references: Fraeman et al., JGR Planets 2020 — Vera Rubin Ridge

targets.name: Greenheugh Pediment Unconformity
targets.description: Major regional angular unconformity separating ancient wet lake mudstones from younger wind-blown Stimson sandstones.
targets.dataSource: NASA MSL Curiosity Mastcam Gigapixel Panorama
missingEvidence: Lower pediment basal contact partially obscured by talus apron

targets.name: Olympus Mons Nested Caldera Complex
targets.description: Amazonian shield volcano summit caldera complex (~21.9 km above Mars datum) recording late-stage mantle plume volcanism and collapse episodes.
targets.dataSource: NASA MGS MOLA Altimetry & Odyssey THEMIS Day/Night IR
missingEvidence: No in-situ rover or lander geochemical measurements available
Thick summit dust mantle obscures primary basaltic bedrock in THEMIS/CRISM IR spectra
references: Plescia, Icarus 2004 — Morphometric properties of Olympus Mons calderas

targets.name: Valles Marineris — Coprates Chasma Layered Escarpment
targets.description: Deep tectonic canyon wall exposing >6 km of Noachian-Hesperian crustal stratigraphy, interior layered sulfate deposits, and recurring slope lineae.
targets.dataSource: NASA MRO HiRISE & CRISM Orbital Spectroscopy
missingEvidence: No landed in-situ XRF/XRD measurements within canyon floor
Steep canyon wall shadows limit continuous HiRISE stereo & CRISM coverage
references: Murchie et al., JGR 2009 — CRISM mineralogic stratigraphy in Valles Marineris

targets.name: Oxia Planum Fe/Mg-Phyllosilicate Plain
targets.description: Extensive Noachian clay-bearing plain and deltaic fan outlet selected as the ExoMars Rosalind Franklin landing site for biosignature preservation.
targets.dataSource: NASA MRO CRISM / HiRISE & ESA Mars Express OMEGA
missingEvidence: ExoMars Rosalind Franklin 2-meter subsurface drilling not yet executed
In-situ organic macromolecule preservation remains unverified
references: Quantin-Nataf et al., Astrobiology 2021 — Oxia Planum landing site

targets.name: Utopia Planitia Scalloped Terrain & Ice Sheet
targets.description: Mid-latitude thermokarst scalloped depressions underlain by a massive tabular water-ice deposit detected via orbital sounding radar.
targets.dataSource: NASA MRO SHARAD Radar Sounding & HiRISE Geomorphology
missingEvidence: Direct core ice purity and salinity sampling unavailable
SHARAD dielectric permittivity inversion carries ~±15% ice-volume fraction uncertainty
references: Stuurman et al., Geophys. Res. Lett. 2016 — SHARAD detection of Utopia Planitia ice deposit
